# Third-party font sources

`space-grotesk-*.woff2` and `manrope-*.woff2` are redistributed here in
derived (WOFF2, subsetted-by-upstream) form under the terms of their
license.

- **Space Grotesk** — designed by Florian Karsten. OFL-1.1 License.
  https://github.com/floriankarsten/space-grotesk
- **Manrope** — designed by Mikhail Sharanda. OFL-1.1 License.
  https://github.com/sharanda/manrope

Fetched via `npm pack @fontsource/space-grotesk @fontsource/manrope`
(the npm registry, not a live CDN) — see `fonts.css` and `css/tokens.css`/
`css/mini-apps.css` for how they're used.
